_purpose: DS-156 corpus-motivated regression fixture for the completion-warrant widening in hooks/enforce-turn-shape.py (test-enforce-turn-shape.py's 'c-*' block). ROUND 2 REBUILD (Skeptic Major 4 on commit cf6bc9d5): every case's 'source' field states which REAL transcript shape it is derived from (a real main-agent turn, sanitized to structure plus the minimal text the predicate needs; a round-1 regression pin; or an explicitly-labelled Skeptic-constructed adversarial probe) - none is authored by describing which regex branch it is meant to exercise. No literal proprietary content (real PR numbers, ticket IDs, filenames, project names) is reproduced; only the completion-relevant wording is kept, matching the same discipline as turn-shape-corpus-samples.json.
_round_numbering_note: This fixture uses a 2-round scheme: 'round 1' = everything shipped in commit cf6bc9d5 (which itself iterated twice internally before shipping - enforce-turn-shape.py's own docstring calls those two internal steps 'round 1' and 'round 2' respectively, so its numbering is one finer-grained than this fixture's); 'round 2' here = the Skeptic-driven correction in THIS commit, which that same hook docstring calls 'round 3'. Both schemes agree on the substance; only the granularity of the label differs.

_measurement.corpus_root: ~/.claude/projects (local developer machine, not committed - this fixture is the sanitized extract)
_measurement.population_note: hooks/enforce-turn-shape.py is registered on the Stop event only (fires for the main agent); subagent turns fire the unregistered SubagentStop event instead. Every figure below is MAIN-AGENT-ONLY (isSidechain absent/false) - round 1 (commit cf6bc9d5) measured the UNFILTERED corpus (~48% sidechain) and both its headline figures and its 'status: DONE' / 'review complete' sentinels were consequently wrong for this hook's actual consumer.
_measurement.round_1_newly_recognised_pct: 10.5% (not the unfiltered-corpus figure of 198/16.1% originally reported)
_measurement.round_1_hand_labelled_full_set: all 103, not a sample - 4 confirmed false positives (3.9%), 7 borderline (Running:-field shape)
_measurement.round_1_false_positive_root_cause: status: DONE / DONE_WITH_CONCERNS contributed 0 of 103 main-agent recognitions (all 72 of its unfiltered-corpus hits were sidechain engineer-role returns); review complete likewise contributed 0. Both deleted outright, not narrowed.
round_2_fixes: delete the status: DONE / DONE_WITH_CONCERNS anywhere-scoped sentinel (0 main-agent contribution, and actively harmful - a conductor relaying a subagent's Status: DONE text must not be read as this turn's own completion)
delete the review complete anywhere-scoped sentinel (0 main-agent contribution)
drop the comma from _LEADING_COMPLETION_RE's terminator class - a trailing comma matched a leading CLAUSE, not a sentence, and ignored whatever continuation followed it

add _has_continuing_work_signal: a non-empty Conductor-template Running: field, or one of three phrases ("one to go", "remaining after", "is/are still running") derived from the 4 confirmed real false positives - vetoes the completion warrant outright when present anywhere in the domain

round_2_result.reverted_breakdown: 4 confirmed false positives + 7 Running:-field cases + 2 further instances of the (is|are) still running phrase

_measurement.round_2_precision: independently hand-labelled all 90 newly-recognised main-agent turns (not sampled): 0 confirmed false positives
_measurement.disclosed_residual_over_suppression: 1 of the 13 reverted turns was itself a genuine completion ("Other Claude Code sessions are still running the pre-refresh hooks" - an unrelated session, not this turn's own dependency) incorrectly caught by the same (is|are) still running phrase that correctly catches the 3 real false positives using that exact shape. Pinned as case A12 with expected=advisory (the current, imperfect behaviour), not chased further - distinguishing "my own dependent work" from "an unrelated process" requires semantic understanding this lexical guard does not have.
_measurement.disclosed_residual_gap_unchanged_from_ro: a completion declared under a markdown sub-heading (e.g. "## Done") rather than the identity line is still not recognised - case A9.

shape_classes_covered.leading_bare_declaration: a short 'X is done/complete' sentence as the very first line of the turn, with NO continuing-work signal anywhere in the turn (cases Q1, Q2, Q6, Q7, Q8)
shape_classes_covered.structured_field_sentinel: the Conductor template's own State: field, anywhere-scoped because the field label itself removes the ambiguity, gated by the sibling Running: field being empty (case Q3)
shape_classes_covered.fixed_workflow_phrase: this repo's recurring PR-review-run closing phrase (case Q4)
shape_classes_covered.leading_past_participle: a leading 'Merged ... cleaned up' declaration (case Q5)
shape_classes_covered.round_1_false_positive_trap_midbody: the round-1 false-positive shape (completion-adjacent phrase in the BODY, not the identity line) - regression pins for round 1's identity-line-scoping fix, unaffected by round 2 (cases A1, A2)
shape_classes_covered.round_2_false_positive_leading_plus_body: the round-2 false-positive shape: a genuinely short, sentence-complete completion declaration ON the identity line, with the still-in-progress signal appearing SEPARATELY in the body - what identity-line-scoping alone could not catch (cases A3, A4, A5, A6)
shape_classes_covered.running_field_active: an anywhere-scoped completion sentinel co-occurring with a non-empty sibling Running: field (case A7)
shape_classes_covered.status_value_confusable: a structured Status: field whose VALUE is not the terminal value, even though the terminal word appears later in unrelated prose (case A8)
shape_classes_covered.disclosed_residual_gap: a genuine completion declared under a markdown sub-heading rather than the identity line - permanent regression pin, not chased (case A9)
shape_classes_covered.relayed_subagent_status: a conductor turn RELAYING a subagent's own Status: DONE text mid-sentence, which must never be read as this turn's own completion (case A10)
shape_classes_covered.leading_clause_not_sentence: a leading declaration followed by a comma-joined continuation clause describing unfinished work - regression pin for the comma-removal fix (case A11)
shape_classes_covered.disclosed_over_suppression_residual: a genuine completion whose closing aside about an UNRELATED session happens to use the same still-running phrase that correctly identifies the real false positives - accepted trade-off, pinned as currently-advisory (case A12)
